post.summary: Queue a full backup export (Super Admin): job BACKUP_EXPORT streams every table into a ZIP (NDJSON + manifest + RESTORE.md); poll GET /admin/backups

KYC workflow (maker-checker): SUBMITTED needs PAN + Aadhaar + a KYC document; VERIFIED/REJECTED only from SUBMITTED by a customer.kyc_view holder who is not the submitter; changing VERIFIED needs settings.manage + reason

get.description: Malformed, forged or expired tokens are 404. The link is bound to the customer it was issued to: a request carrying any bearer token other than that customer's own portal token is 404 too. Without a bearer the signed link itself is the credential (PDF viewers and share sheets).
get.summary: Stream a portal file through its signed, short-lived, customer-bound link (generated PDFs, shared documents, photos)
Live notices: company-wide plus the projects of the customer's bookings

post.description: multipart/form-data with a single `file` part (PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP ≤ 15 MB, validated by file signature). The returned document_id is then carried in a reply's attachment_ids — or, with a `message_id` text part naming one of your own messages on this request (the opening message after create), the file is appended to that message right away.
